title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - GTIN14ID
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/GTIN14ID . GTIN-14 (EAN/UCC-14 or ITF-14, also known as ITF Symbol, SCC-14, DUN-14, UPC Case Code, UPC Shipping Container Code, UCC Code 128, EAN Code 128) is a 14-digit number used to identify trade items at various packaging levels. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasGTIN14IDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GTIN14ID'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasGTIN14IDValue.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasGTIN14IDValue'. The value of the GTIN-14 identifier as a 14-digit string.
